sentences.text:
This petition coming on for admission upon perusing the petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of SRI.DILEEP P.PILLAI Advocate for the petitioner, GOVERNMENT PLEADER for respondents 1 & 3 and of SRI.DEEPU THANKAN, Advocate for respondent 2, the court passed the following:
 V.G.ARUN, J.
 ============================
 W.P.(C) No.25233 of 2024  ---------------------------
 Dated this the 12th day of July, 2024  ORDER Admit.
Anandhu.
Learned Government Pleader takes notice for R1 and R3.
Adv.Deepu Thankan takes notice for R2.

Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that the only crime registered against him is for an offence under Section 498A of IPC and hence, there is no requirement for producing the non- involvement in offences.
This is an aspect which the authority should consider when the petitioner appears before it.

If the petitioner applies for a document containing the details of the crime registered against him,
the third respondent shall issue the same.

Sd/-
V.G.ARUN JUDGE Scl/ 12-07-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Anandhu.B vs State Of Kerala on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153340318/
